characters.name: art-frog
characters.prompt: A chunky cartoon frog mascot. FACE, IMPORTANT: two VERY LARGE round eyes, each as wide as a quarter of the face, placed HIGH on the head near the top, white eyeballs with big black pupils, flush with the head surface and inside its silhouette, NOT bulging outside it. A VERY WIDE dark mouth line curving into a smile, stretching all the way across the lower face from one cheek to the other. Two small nostril dots above the mouth. Bright grass green skin, small red collared shirt, dark green trousers, green feet. PROPORTIONS: a rounded head NO WIDER than the shoulders, joined to the torso by a short visible green neck; a tall torso; two thick arms; two thick legs as long as the torso. POSE, MANDATORY: a wide A-pose. Both arms point outward and downward at 45 degrees, well away from the torso, with plain white background clearly visible under each armpit. The legs are straight and set apart with plain white background visible between the thighs. The character is clearly TALLER than it is wide
